crossRefs.note: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Return from me. That which…

parallels.note: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled…

translations.web: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
translations.bsb: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
translations.kjv: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
translations.asv: Thou sayest (but they are but vain words), There is counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou hast rebelled against me?
